Our 2025/26 Season

WELCOME TO OUR 2025-26 SEASON!

Our 2025/26 season features Tony Award®-winning artists, a world premiere play, and a critically acclaimed new play with music. The MCC Youth Company returns, sharing their unique perspectives in their annual UNCENSORED production, and developing playwrights share their work through FRESHPLAY readings and festival. Join us for illuminating stories and thought-provoking experiences meant to continue the conversations long after the curtain closes.

Purchase your 2025-26 season package and enjoy our productions with priority access to the best seats, discounted additional tix, and more. Get even more access and benefits by joining our Patron Program.

LEARN MORE

BIRTHRIGHT

PERFORMANCES BEGIN JUN 2026

The Newman Mills Theater

What begins as a reunion among six young friends after a Birthright trip to Israel in 2006 becomes, over the span of 18 years, an exploration of identity, fracturing communities, and what it means to belong in BIRTHRIGHT by Tony Award® winner JONATHAN SPECTOR (EUREKA DAY) and directed by TEDDY BERGMAN (MOTHER RUSSIA).

Tracing a generation through the lens of American Jewish life, BIRTHRIGHT is a portrait of friendship across time. In an era defined by social media, their conversations evolve, capturing the complicated, funny, and deeply real experience of staying close.

Birthright is produced by Special Arrangement with Jenny Gersten, Sonia Friedman Productions, and FourthWall Theatrical. Birthright was commissioned and developed by Miami New Drama. World Premiere presented by Miami New Drama, April 2024, Michel Hausmann-Artistic Director; Nicholas Richberg-Managing Director.

More

UNCENSORED

APRIL 11-12 & 16-19,  2026

The Susan & Ronald Frankel Theater

The atmosphere is collapsing. The clock is ticking down to zero. And the youth of New York City have decided to throw one final, unapologetic party before the lights go out. UNCENSORED: NO NEED TO OVERTHINK IT isn’t a polite play about teenagers, it is a fierce, funny, and explosive original work devised by the 16 artists of the 2026 MCC Youth Company Performance Lab Ensemble. Come witness a generation reclaim the narrative, confront the chaos of tomorrow, and dance brilliantly at the edge of the abyss.

Cast Talkback FRI APRIL 17

 

More

COLD WAR CHOIR PRACTICE

FEB 21-APR 5,  2026

The Newman Mills Theater

In this celebrated play directed by Tony Award nominee KNUD ADAMS (ENGLISH), a prominent Black conservative brings his mysteriously ill wife home for the holidays, setting long simmering tensions with his estranged family to boil. A fugue of Reaganomics, espionage, roller disco, and cults—underscored by the Syracuse, NY chapter of the Seedlings of Peace Children’s Chorus.

A Co-Production with Clubbed Thumb and Page 73

 

More

FRESHPLAY FESTIVAL

FEB 21,  2026

STUDIO 1

FRESHPLAY FESTIVAL is a collection of plays written by members of the Playwriting Lab and selected for a full workshop process and staged reading. The Youth Company playwrights work side by side with seasoned directors, designers, dramaturgs, and actors to bring their plays to life.

Playwriting Lab students spent the fall of 2025 writing original, ten-minute and one-act plays under the guidance of JUAN RAMIREZ, JR. These students have continued to develop their plays this winter for our FRESHPLAY FESTIVAL, which features an afternoon of staged readings of their work in collaboration with professional actors and directors.

More

CAROLINE

SEP 12-NOV 16, 2025

Susan & Ronald Frankel Theater

A world premiere play starring AMY LANDECKER (BUG, “TRANSPARENT”), RIVER LIPE-SMITH (Geva Theatre’s A CHRISTMAS CAROL), and CHLOË GRACE MORETZ (“THE PERIPHERAL,” THE MISEDUCATION OF CAMERON POST). Written by PRESTON MAX ALLEN (WE ARE THE TIGERS) and directed by Tony Award Winner DAVID CROMER (DEAD OUTLAW, GOOD NIGHT, AND GOOD LUCK), CAROLINE is a luminous and intimate story about the possibility of redemption and the complex relationships between generations of mothers and daughters.

Official tickets for MCC Theater performances are available only by purchasing through our website at mcctheater.org, calling Audience Services at (646) 506-9393, or visiting our theater during Box Office hours. Please be wary of other sites claiming to sell tickets to our events. MCC Theater’s official third-party ticketing partners are TodayTix and TDF. We do not endorse other third-party sites and cannot guarantee or verify the validity of any tickets purchased in this way if entry into our venues is attempted with an illegitimate ticket or a ticket obtained under fraudulent circumstances. In that case, we will not honor such tickets even if money was exchanged between you and a non-endorsed sales channel. MCC Theater is not financially responsible for any monetary loss you incur in third-party ticket transactions. Inquiries regarding purchases made through any third-party site should be directed to the original point of purchase.
